label: SQL Injection Detection No Longer Misses Repeated Queries
desc: When a page showed a SQL query as an example and then built the same query for real in a script, the scanner scored the real one against the example's surroundings and reported nothing. It now checks every occurrence where it actually appears, so a genuine SQL injection pattern is still reported even if the same query text also appears as sample content elsewhere on the page.

label: AI-Code Checks Now Look At Every Match, Not Just The First
desc: Two vibe-code checks stopped after examining the first thing they found. A harmless comment such as "password: minimum 8 characters" near the top of a file hid a real leftover password further down, and a friendly error string embedded as translation data hid the same string sitting inside real error-handling code. Both checks now review every occurrence, so these findings are no longer silently dropped.
